signals: Found multiple elements with the role
Found multiple elements with the text:
entries.cause: Global Testing Library query matches repeated controls or duplicated text.
entries.hint: Scope to the relevant row/card first, then query with within(row). Prefer unique accessible names over global getByRole/getByText.

signals: Unable to find an accessible element with the role
entries.cause: getByRole uses the accessible name (aria-label), which may differ from visible button text.
entries.hint: Check aria-label / accessible name before changing UI. Match getByRole name to the accessible name, not only the visible label.

entries.cause: Tests leak state via localStorage / module-time storage capture across cases.
entries.hint: Clear the actual JSDOM localStorage the store uses (beforeEach/afterEach). If the store captures storage at import time, do not replace globalThis.localStorage after import — clear the captured storage instead.
